workflow_scale_routing.rationale: One written artifact can hold the movement through text sections without long-work stewardship.
reroute_triggers: Artist requests dependent parts, a sequence or series, durable canon, or long-form drafting across sessions.

writing_method.rationale: The output needs a compact reader-facing fragment that still follows the approved threshold beat.

medium_output_shape_recommendation.rationale: The approved threshold beat needs a concise reader-facing form that can hook through image, turn through pressure, and stop before resolution.
tradeoffs: The artist statement improves viewer orientation but risks over-explaining the threshold.
The monologue influence preserves intimacy but cannot replace the public-facing statement function.

cultural_format_structure.name: Reflective Artist Statement
cultural_format_structure.audience_promise: The viewer will understand the threshold image as unresolved emotional pressure rather than a literal doorway scene.
cultural_format_structure.audience_hook: Open with the concrete key so the statement begins in image before explanation.

parts.label: Hook
parts.function: Begin with a concrete image that creates curiosity before interpretation.

parts.label: Residue
parts.function: Leave the viewer with the withheld crossing instead of a resolved explanation.

cultural_format_structure.turn_or_payoff: The statement reframes the doorway as pressure held open, not a passage completed.
failure_modes: ending with a lesson instead of residue

text_form.rationale: An artist statement can name the meaning while the monologue influence keeps the threshold intimate.
avoid: turning the key into a lesson

voice_point_of_view.speaker: the artist
voice_point_of_view.point_of_view: first person plural avoided; direct first person singular allowed sparingly

structure_plan.structure_rationale: Three short sections let the text move from object, to pressure, to refusal without pretending the decision resolves.

sections.section_job: Introduce the key as agency that cannot yet be used.
sections.intended_feeling: the ache of being close to release but unable to choose it
sections.expectation_turn_translation: The object that should unlock entry becomes proof that entry is still impossible.
source_wording_notes: May adapt the source image of the key; do not quote private lines verbatim.
sections.paragraph_distinction: This section stays tactile and object-focused.

sections.section_job: Make welcome feel dangerous without losing tenderness.
sections.expectation_turn_translation: The lit doorway promises safety but increases the risk of crossing.
source_wording_notes: Keep the doorway image; adapt surrounding language.
sections.paragraph_distinction: This section shifts from object to atmosphere.

sections.section_job: Stop before the decision and let the refusal carry the ending.
sections.expectation_turn_translation: The expected crossing never arrives; the ending preserves suspended choice.
source_wording_notes: Do not invent a decision or aftermath.
sections.paragraph_distinction: This section should be shorter and more withheld than the first two.

source_wording_constraints: preserve threshold, key, and active absence as images
fidelity_policy.rights_notes: Use only artist-provided source material inside this project.
fidelity_policy.rationale: The new text should preserve the source images without copying private phrasing verbatim.

publication_use.audience: viewers encountering the work beside an image or installation
publication_use.privacy_notes: Keep personal biography implied rather than explicit.

traceability_summary.note: All sections preserve the threshold beat and its withheld crossing.
